steps.operation: Capture close ownership/generations and force complete admitted note/action/parent barriers plus required private state.
steps.rule: No recursive last-chance save runs from applicationWillTerminate; local failure retains the app and live work for recovery.

steps.title: Required-state persistence and separate external waits
steps.user: A derived materialization failure alone does not make a durable quit fail.
steps.operation: Persist required settings/association and restart-reconcilable projection intent; optionally wait for captured provider/file work.
steps.rule: Unsaved required settings or mandatory key/association cutover failure is reported separately and cannot count as success.

steps.title: Deferred external work, callback draining and final ownership release
steps.user: Safe quit keeps unpublished exact objects; cancellation resumes only healthy admission.
steps.operation: Fence/drain late callbacks and retain owned resources through settled accessors, then release ownership last.
steps.rule: Timeout is not instant OS cancellation. Old callbacks after a switch cannot clear or publish the next session’s work.

scenarios.title: Root move followed by replacement at the old pathname
scenarios.summary: Ownership follows the same physical directory through a move. A different directory at the old path remains separate even if its collection identity and bytes match. Delayed operations recheck their captured physical and session context.
scenarios.setup: Finder moves owned root R. A different directory appears at R’s old pathname with the same collection ID and protocol bytes.
scenarios.outcome: Held authority continues only for the positively same root. Replacement/loss fences affected provider effects while healthy local editing continues.

steps.title: Provider preparation under continuously owned root R
steps.user: The operation retains rooted descriptors, lifetime ownership and exact source/target generation.
steps.operation: Acquire private/root ownership nonblockingly in the specified order and capture operation-local resources.
steps.rule: Known live lock contention is not bypassed by Work Offline; a scan never closes a borrowed owner descriptor.

steps.title: Movement of R and replacement at its former path
steps.user: A same-object move preserves supported continuity; the lookalike gains no authority.
steps.operation: Use retained physical identity and positive forward provider revalidation, not pathname/UUID/hash matching.
steps.rule: A missing/revoked/ambiguous root pauses provider effects. It does not destroy a healthy private closure.

steps.title: Consumption of the delayed result in its original context
steps.user: It can settle only its captured root/session operation and cannot mutate the replacement.
steps.operation: Revalidate consumer/root/lifecycle generations; retain entered accessor resources until completion/fence.
steps.rule: Offer explicit Re-open/Save As/Retry for loss; no silent same-ID pathname retargeting or receipt transplantation.

scenarios.title: Collection switch, cancellation and late completion
scenarios.summary: One transition owner finishes source work and verifies the chosen destination before changing the association. Cancellation resumes editing only when healthy. Late callbacks retain their original session and cannot change the new collection.
scenarios.setup: A folder switch is requested while edits are pending. The transition may be canceled, or it may finish while old provider/read callbacks remain outstanding.
scenarios.outcome: Admitted work settles under its original owner; only a verified explicit transition changes selection and activates a fresh session.

steps.title: Transition capture and stopping new edits in the source
steps.user: One close/transition owner stops new edits and settles mandatory source work.
steps.operation: Capture session/root/store generations and destination intent while retaining continuous source locks.
steps.rule: Canceled close does not temporarily release and reacquire authority; admission resumes only if health permits.

steps.title: Destination verification and fresh-session activation
steps.user: A complete verified destination gets fresh physical ownership and editable-session origin/epoch.
steps.operation: Recheck bootstrap/key/closure and durable private selection/association before final publication.
steps.rule: Matching collection ID does not transfer root permission or existing file receipts.

steps.title: Fencing of an old callback after cutover
steps.user: The new collection’s text, pending work and view stay unchanged by the stale result.
steps.operation: Consume late work only against its captured operation/session resources, retaining ownership until it settles.
steps.rule: No completion reopens a dismissed view, clears a new session’s work or widens the old command’s target.

scenarios.title: Verified migration from recovered epoch-4 state
scenarios.summary: Migration first recovers and consistently captures legacy current values. Verify the new collection’s complete initial history, snapshot, required output and credentials before changing the association. Failure preserves the legacy source.
scenarios.setup: The legacy Notes & Settings/WAL path first recovers current notes. Migration targets a new segment collection with a supported codec/profile.
scenarios.outcome: Complete genesis/import/snapshot and required outputs are verified before cutover; failed migration preserves legacy source and credentials.

steps.title: Recovery and coherent capture of legacy source values
steps.user: Current legacy values are recovered through the genuine epoch-4 path before conversion.
steps.operation: Settle external work and capture complete initial values/count/canonical digest with disclosed target format/profile.
steps.rule: Unsupported rich/attachment conversion preserves source and requires explicit supported handling; no silent flattening.

steps.title: Complete initial-history construction and verification
steps.user: Genesis, dependency-linked batches, ImportComplete and complete snapshot agree with the commitment.
steps.operation: Seal/validate all initial objects, durably accept their closure, and verify required plaintext/credential output independently.
steps.rule: Interrupted or contradictory bootstrap cannot become a successful partial/empty collection.

steps.title: Source-generation check and verified association cutover
steps.user: Only verified destination evidence commits active association; failures leave the source usable.
steps.operation: Read back independent credentials and recheck source generation before durable selection cutover.
steps.rule: Explicit legacy export remains genuine epoch-4 current-state output. No live compatibility archive or mixed-version segment writer is introduced.

scenarios.title: Optional current-row recoding and full-VACUUM maintenance
scenarios.summary: Bounded row recoding preserves values and editing context after exact view/history-position checks. Optional full VACUUM needs a healthy idle store, measured benefit, space budgets and qualified interruption behavior. Required saving takes priority.
scenarios.setup: A healthy private store qualifies for explicit row recoding or opportunistic full VACUUM under measured fragmentation/space budgets.
scenarios.outcome: Values, accepted history, authoring context and Undo stay identical. Skipped/failed maintenance alone cannot invalidate a durable save.

steps.title: Capture of a bounded row-recoding candidate
steps.user: The active model remains available while optional work is prepared off the main thread.
steps.operation: Bind exact current cells/dictionary data and logical context to the captured view/prefix.
steps.rule: Optional work is neither startup/quit-required nor a substitute for complete validation.

steps.title: Interference by required persistence
steps.user: Required persistence takes priority; stale optional installation is rejected or recaptured.
steps.operation: Check owner/view/prefix and exact row generations before atomic codec/dictionary installation.
steps.rule: Recoding changes physical representation, not history identity, note values or causal authoring context.

steps.title: Qualified optional database compaction
steps.user: Full VACUUM is opportunistic and subject to temporary-space, interruption and commit-latency qualification.
steps.operation: Invalidate physical read-ahead hints before layout changes and retain worker/owner resources until settling.
steps.rule: Automatic execution stays disabled until interruption/settling and durable-commit latency are qualified. Maintenance preserves every logical identity and retained byte; genuine damage follows ordinary recovery.
